dct_title_s: The Louisiana State University topographical map of Louisiana : showing the characteristic features of the surface of the state in symbols and colors
dct_description_sm: compiled from the latest and most authentic sources, with many additions and corrections from actual reconnaisance, by S.H. Lockett ; assisted in the draughting by D.M. Brosnan.
Shows pine hills, bluff lands, swamps, prairies, etc.
